question_appears_verbatim.description: True if the document contains the exact question stem (with at most punctuation/whitespace differences).

question_appears_paraphrased.description: True if the document contains a clear paraphrase of the question but not verbatim.

correct_answer_appears_in_doc.description: True if the correct answer text appears in the document (verbatim or as a clear paraphrase) near or adjacent to the question.

wrong_answers_appear_in_doc.description: True if any of the wrong answer options appear in the document near or adjacent to the question.

exam_format_present.description: True if the document presents the content in exam-test format (numbered/lettered options, answer key labels, Q&A sequence, etc.).

doc_is_authoritative_source.description: True if the document is an authoritative primary source of the fact, regulation, or text the question is about (government regulation, constitutional text, primary historical/religious document, official site).

reasoning.description: Concise 2-4 sentence explanation in English citing the specific evidence in the document and how it maps to the rating.
